definitionZh: Min-hight CSS 属性设定元素最小高度. 它防止高度属性的用值变得小于指定的毫高值.
sourceDefinition: The min-height CSS property sets the minimum height of an element. It prevents the used value of the height property from becoming smaller than the value specified for min-height.
